On Thu, Nov 6, 2025 at 10:03 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —

Short technical take: we should NOT buy the Buildkite registry add-on if CloudRegistry can handle our container storage more cost-effectively. Current infra notes:

- Our container push volume has jumped 2.2x in the last 6 months because of daily model builds. We are seeing cold-layer duplication across repos.
- CloudRegistry contract (expiring Q2 2026) already includes a storage tier with lifecycle policies we can tighten to reduce active storage.
- Buildkite's S3 add-on may add operational friction (extra auth/role mapping) and duplicate egress costs.

Recommendation: negotiate for Buildkite to waive the registry add-on (or reduce fee) and keep auth integration as a supported connector. Ask for a per-GB break point (e.g., $0.012/GB tier below 10TB) if we must go through them.

Action: I'll spin up a short usage report (by repo/team) and share numbers by EOD Monday.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Lead DevOps Engineer | Redwood Inference

- 5TB committed storage (S3-backed), $4,800/year (includes lifecycle pruning to reduce duplicates).
- Network egress tiers: first 2TB/month included; $0.01/GB overage beyond that.
- Integration assistance: one day of professional services to wire auth/roles for $1,200 (waivable with a 12-month commitment).

Team —

Thanks for the fast turn-around. Summary and decisions:

1) Hold on the Buildkite registry add-on. Grace's analysis + Marco's CloudRegistry pricing makes them the better fit for storage economics.
2) Buildkite enterprise renewal: accept the 10% uplift but request early-sign 5% discount (deadline 2025-12-01). Request removal of automatic 12-month auto-renew clause and add standard audit/SLR language. Laura — can you prepare a short redline to push on those two items?
3) Engage CloudRegistry: Marco's SOW looks reasonable. Vivek — please confirm budget for the $4,800 committed storage + one-time $1,200 PS (or request waiver). If approved, I'll ask Marco for a DocuSign package and coordinate signatures.

Action items:
- Laura to deliver redline draft by 2025-11-14.
- Vivek to confirm budget by 2025-11-14 and loop finance procurement.
- Grace to share the usage report Monday (attached to this thread once ready).
- I will request Buildkite to provide a DocuSign link with the 5% early-sign discount condition applied if possible.

If all OK, target execution window: sign by 2025-11-28 to lock pricing and avoid Jan service interruption.

Thanks — Karthik
